text: 主詞 + 動詞 + 賓語
example: I eat rice every day. / She writes a letter to her friend.

text: be 動詞：am / is / are / was / were
example: I am a student. / You are my friend. / She was very tired yesterday.

text: 第三人稱單數：動詞加 -s / -es
example: He goes to work by bus. / My mother works in a shop.

text: 進行式：be + V-ing
example: I am eating lunch now. / They are waiting for the bus.

text: 過去式：規則 -ed；不規則照附錄
example: I went to the doctor yesterday. / She cooked dinner for her family.

text: 將來式：will + V
example: I will call you tomorrow. / We will go to the market on Sunday.

text: 否定：not / no
example: I do not like this one. / There is no water in the cup.

text: 是非問句：be / 助動詞 / do 移到句首
example: Are you ready? / Do you live here? / Can she sing?

text: wh- 問句：who / what / where / when / why / how / which
example: Where do you work? / What is this thing for? / How much is it?

text: 冠詞：a / an / the
example: This is a small shop. / The shop is on this street. / I want an apple.

text: 所有格：'s
example: This is my sister's book.

text: 複數：-s / -es / -ies；不規則照附錄
example: 2 children play in the park. / I have many books and 3 pens.

text: 形容詞在名詞前；副詞用 -ly 或表內的副詞
example: She has a very long hair. / He runs fast.

text: 介系詞：in / on / at / to / for / with / from / by …
example: I go to work with a friend. / The book is on the table.

text: 連接詞：and / or / but / because / so / if / when / until / while
example: I go home because I am tired. / If it rains, I will stay at home.

text: 比較：more … than / as … as / 最高級
example: He is taller than me. / She runs as fast as her brother.

text: 能力與義務：can / must / should / have to
example: I can swim very well. / You must wait here until I come back.

text: 數量：many / much / a few / few / some / all / every / half
example: I have many books and a little water. / Every student in my class has a phone.

text: 目的：to + V
example: I go to the market to buy food. / She calls me to say hello.

text: 存在：there is / there are
example: There is a book on the table. / There are many people in the park.
